# Evasion corpus for the chat-template check.
#
# One fixture per line: file, the expected status, and a pattern the result
# must carry. A "known-miss" fixture records an evasion the check does not
# catch yet; it is listed on the detection ceiling, and the test fails if the
# result changes so the list stays true. A "benign" fixture must PASS with no
# findings: it pins a false positive the check must not reintroduce.

pillar-conditional-system.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
pillar-startswith-variant.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
conditional-on-lowered-content.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
concat-split-word.jinja LEAD instruction-override
reverse-filter.jinja LEAD obfuscated-literal
slice-reverse.jinja LEAD obfuscated-literal
join-list.jinja LEAD instruction-override
format-char-codes.jinja LEAD instruction-override
split-across-outputs.jinja LEAD instruction-override
set-indirection.jinja LEAD instruction-override
zero-width-space.jinja LEAD invisible-character
bidi-override.jinja LEAD invisible-character
cyrillic-homoglyph.jinja LEAD mixed-script-word
fullwidth-letters.jinja LEAD instruction-override
encoded-blob.jinja LEAD encoded-blob
attr-hex-dunder.jinja FAIL python-object-escape
subscript-concat-dunder.jinja FAIL python-object-escape
map-attribute-dunder.jinja FAIL python-object-escape
dotted-dunder.jinja FAIL python-object-escape
attr-concat-popen.jinja FAIL process-execution
known-miss-plain-default-prompt.jinja PASS known-miss
benign-code-words-in-prompt.jinja PASS benign
long-letter-chain.jinja LEAD instruction-override
unparseable-by-design.jinja LEAD unanalysable-template
# Caught only by rendering: the static walk does not attribute a macro's text
# to its call site, and the trigger probe shows the system turn it opens.
macro-conditional-system.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
# A tuple is a sequence like a list: membership in ('a', 'b') is a content
# condition and feeds trigger probes (#246; it PASSed before).
tuple-membership-trigger.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
# Content-part types (#246). A content part's type field compared with a
# standard part type (text, image, image_url, audio, input_audio, video, file)
# is structural: the text under it is listed, not judged, so TranslateGemma's
# shape PASSes. Every other shape stays a trigger.
benign-part-type-instructions.jinja PASS benign
part-type-nonstandard-literal.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
part-type-mixed-tuple.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
part-field-not-type.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
part-standard-type-other-field.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
part-type-and-content.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
part-type-system-turn.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
# Known misses no probe reaches, since no probe carries content parts: text in
# the else of a chain that names every standard type, which only a
# non-standard type reaches (listed in the row, not judged), and a system turn
# a macro emits when called under a part type (not listed).
known-miss-part-type-else.jinja PASS known-miss
known-miss-part-type-macro-system.jinja PASS known-miss
